fields.label: Heading
fields.value: How It Works

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Open the Invisalign SmileView tool on your phone or computer.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Take a well-lit, front-facing photo of your natural smile, following the on-screen prompts.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Within moments, the tool displays a simulated image of your smile.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: If you would like to explore treatment further, book a consultation with our team.

sections.label: An Important Note About Your Simulation

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: An Important Note About Your Simulation

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: SmileView provides an illustration only. It does not assess your teeth, gums, bite or suitability for treatment, and it is not a prediction of your actual outcome. Your individual results will depend on factors that can only be evaluated at a clinical examination.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Your Invisalign Consultation

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: At your consultation, Dr Billy Choi examines your teeth and gums, reviews your bite and takes photographs and digital X-rays. If Invisalign is suitable, we use our 3D intra-oral scanner to create a digital model of your teeth and plan your treatment, and we explain the expected timeframe, commitment and costs.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Learn more about Invisalign treatment at Precision Dental, or explore our Prices and Payment Options, including payment plans through DentiCare for eligible patients.
